verses.text: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
lines: Save me, God, by your name.

verses.text: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
lines: Listen to the words of my mouth.

verses.text: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them.
lines: For strangers have risen up against me.
Violent men have sought after my soul.
They haven’t set God before them.

verses.text: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
lines: The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

verses.text: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
lines: He will repay the evil to my enemies.

verses.text: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.
lines: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you.
I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

verses.text: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
lines: For he has delivered me out of all trouble.
My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
